answer_1.quote: We conduct our experiments on three widely-used datasets: AlpacaEval, WMT19 (de-en) and TruthfulQA. Following prior work on multi-objective alignment, we evaluate helpfulness on AlpacaEval and WMT19 (de-en), and truthfulness on TruthfulQA.
answer_1.outputs: Generated responses for helpfulness, truthfulness, and translation quality

answer_2.quote: We propose the DBG score, which measures the degree of a model's self-preference bias as the difference between the scores it assigns to its own responses and the corresponding gold judgments.
